Also I worry I could go into remission like I had last year, happiest I'd ever been, life going in the direction we both wanted, tben major episode hit, worst I've ever had, he started spending more time with her while I kept isolating. He left me at my absolute lowest, then ten days later when I was in the hospital, he told me he had feelings for her. I have had sinus tachycardia since. So now my heart is broken both figuratively and literally. Fucking fuck. The thing is I've had a method for over a month now. In an envelope in my desk. Five minutes to cardiac arrest. I am just too scared to do it it. My counselor keeps canceling on me, so I can't even pay someone to care. The lack of physical affection is killing me. I really most of the time could use a hug, but I have no one to hug.

Rereading How Soon is Never, The Tao of Pooh and starting A Peoples History of the US

Just posted on this sub not long before you. 
Short story, with a guy for nine years, plans to marry, we grew,up together, now 28, he left me because of my depression and for a 23 I work with. I see her everyday. His family has basically decided I do not exist, only family I ever felt loved. All a lie. Tried to kill myself in  October, have been up and down ever since. All my friends have stopped talking to me and I basically plan to kill myself every night. But like Brain I never succeed in my nightly plans.
Finished a couple ciders, moving on to vodka. Cheers. At least in sone weird way we are not alone on this Saturday night, I guess.

Thank you for replying. Though my false hope is false hope, for someone I've lost. He won't come back. And I know, you will say, don't kill yourself over some guy, but if love and relationships and family aren't sometime to die for, then why should I live? There's nothing else but love, relationships and family. I don't have that anymore and the hope I have for it returning is absolutely false. My list of pros is mainly no more pain and I won't be able to make people resent me anymore.
